headline: Colombian Stock Market Outperforms Wall Street with 25.3% Annual Gain
summary: The Colombian stock market accumulated a 25.3% valuation gain over the past 12 months, though Corficolombiana warns that future gains depend on corporate earnings performance.
why: Emerging market equity performance tracking provides comparative return metrics against global indices like Wall Street.

impacts.why: Index valuation gains reflect strong historical returns for local equities.
